metadata.question: Does the vegetation coverage in the Inner Niger Delta increase in November 2022 compared to May 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Inner Niger Delta is in Mali (approx. 14-16°N, 4-6°W). Collection: Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for 10 m NDVI. Dates: 1–30 Nov 2022 vs 1–31 May 2022. If Sentinel-2 has zero images we’ll try Landsat 8/9 SR (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2 & LC09) as fallback. 2. Masking: Use SCL band to keep pixels = 4 (vegetation) or 5 (bare soils) and mask clouds/cloud-shadow (classes 8,9,10). Build NDVI, then per-pixel “vegetation coverage” = NDVI > 0.4 (reasonable green vegetation threshold). Compute % coverage inside the delta polygon. 3. Logic: - If either collection size == 0 ⇒ C1. - After masking, if total valid pixels == 0 ⇒ C2. - Mean coverage % is None/NaN ⇒ C3. - Otherwise compare Nov vs May: if Nov % > May % ⇒ A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry – Inner Niger Delta approximate bounds delta = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[4.0, 16.0], [4.0, 14.0], [6.0, 14.0], [6.0, 16.0]]]) def veg_coverage(month_start, month_end, year, label, tries_s2=True): if tries_s2: col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(delta) .filterDate(f'{year}-{month_start}-01', f'{year}-{month_end}-30')) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(delta) .filterDate(f'{year}-{month_start}-01', f'{year}-{month_end}-30')) else: col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterBounds(delta) .filterDate(f'{year}-{month_start}-01', f'{year}-{month_end}-30')) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 # Cloud mask & NDVI def maskS2(img): scl = img.select('SCL') mask = scl.eq(4).Or(scl.eq(5)) return img.updateMask(mask).normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).rename('NDVI') def maskL8(img): qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL') mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)) return img.updateMask(mask).normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('NDVI') if 'COPERNICUS' in col.getInfo()['features'][0]['id']: col = col.map(maskS2) else: col = col.map(maskL8) mosaic = col.median() cov = mosaic.gt(0.4).rename('cov') total = cov.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=delta, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('cov') mean = cov.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=delta, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('cov') return mean.getInfo(), total.getInfo() nov, npx = veg_coverage(11,11,2022,'Nov') may, mpx = veg_coverage(5,5,2022,'May') if nov is None or may is None: print("C1") elif npx == 0 or mpx == 0: print("C2") elif nov is None or may is None: print("C3") else: print(f"Nov22 cover: {nov:.3f} May22: {may:.3f} Pixels: {int(npx)}") print("A" if nov > may else "B") ```
